body.x: Smart Geotech Co., Ltd. announced its participation in CES 2024, which will be held in Las Vegas, USA, from January 9th (Tue) to 12th (Fri, local time).

Established in 2017, Smart Geotech specializes in developing and supplying ICT convergence products for disaster safety, focusing on high-sensitivity sensor-based measurement systems using Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The company has developed and provided disaster safety management products such as "Smart Early Warning System for Predicting Slope Failure (SWS)" and "Smart Steel Pipe Multi-Layer System".

With numerous awards, including the IR52 Jang Young Shil Award and the Korea Safety Technology Award, as well as multiple patents and certifications domestically and internationally, Smart Geotech possesses advanced technological capabilities. A representative of Smart Geotech stated, "Our company contributes to building the smart city ecosystem and actively strives to develop Eco-Design products using renewable energy for greenhouse gas reduction under the UN climate change agreement."

He continued, "For effective smart city construction for urban disaster prevention in developing countries, we establish and demonstrate a customized solution that provides early warning for landslides in Sakarya Metropolitan Municipality, Turkey. Through this global demonstration project, we are proving the efficiency and reliability of the ground collapse detection and prediction solution for smart cities nationally."

At CES 2024, Smart Geotech will showcase the intelligent sensor-based displacement measurement system Smart Early Warning System For Predicting Slope Failure (SWS) at 'Eureka Park,' where innovative startup products are gathered.

body.cap: Smart Early Warning System For Predicting Slope Failure (SWS) System Diagram │Provided by Smart Geotech

body.x: 'Smart Early Warning System For Predicting Slope Failure (SWS)' is a product utilizing state-of-the-art disaster prevention technology with IoT optimization. It is capable of precisely detecting and monitoring micro displacements at 0.01mm. Comprising a smart displacement sensor, IoT sensor nodes, and a gateway for real-time alerts, 'Smart Early Warning System For Predicting Slope Failure (SWS)' secures crucial response time in landslides and rockfalls through pre-detection and early warning. This effectively reduces casualties and property damage, as explained by the company representative.

body.cap: Smart Early Warning System For Predicting Slope Failure (SWS) Solar Sensor │Provided by Smart Geotech

body.x: 'Smart Early Warning System For Predicting Slope Failure (SWS)' stands out for its ability to operate accurately and efficiently without requiring additional specialized personnel, utilizing automated monitoring and machine learning algorithms. Its intuitive design allows for easy installation and can achieve accurate measurements regardless of the slope. Additionally, it features an Eco-Design using environmentally friendly, low-power renewable energy and a low-cost, high-efficiency system that enables remote troubleshooting.

The representative mentioned, "With a flexible structure that smoothly integrates various sensors and applications, 'Smart Early Warning System For Predicting Slope Failure (SWS)' is optimized for IoT, ensuring rapid data transmission and accuracy. The bar-type displacement sensor using wireless communication demonstrates outstanding adaptability even in resource-limited environments. It performs global demonstration projects as a customized solution for urban disaster prevention, proving efficiency and reliability."
